_comment: Hook event key names (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse) match Antigravity CLI's documented hook system as of this writing. Verify against your installed CLI version's schema (e.g. `agy hooks --help`) and adjust key names if they differ - the scripts themselves are the important, portable part.

SessionStart.description: Remind the session which spec file is canon before any work starts.
SessionStart.run: echo 'RailFog session start: docs/contracts/*.md is canon (derived from the LTS spec). See docs/00-deep-analysis.md #1 before implementing anything the contracts do not cover.'

PreToolUse.description: Block obviously destructive shell commands before execution.

PostToolUse.description: Run deno fmt/lint/check after any file edit so verification claims are backed by real output.
